source: PowerPoint 16.0 Slide.Export PNG, original document before edits
checks: Inline and display equations do not overlap; integrals, limits, fractions, radicals and matrices are present.
Mean x-bar retains its overline; table formulas and merged cell text are visible.
Bar and combination charts show zero and negative measurements without changing their values.
Scatter and bubble charts preserve numeric X spacing; a zero-size bubble has zero visual area.
Pie and area charts retain categories, values, legends and negative area data.
Native diagram shapes retain appearance and layer order; group geometry is not applied twice.
limitations: This is a synthetic five-slide acceptance fixture, not an acceptance claim for every research project.
Native chart labels and plot layout are produced by PowerPoint and may differ from ECharts.
Advanced chart families use explicit object-level image fallback.
